plan.admission: Before each long HTTP dispatch require all four successful official warmups, native PID/SID/executable/effective environment, successful batched mode2 drafter-ring markers with exact8192/tail callback cell conservation, and no native errors. Mode denotes placement, not storage precision; reject a fully-resident fallback0 to preserve matched placement. plan.decisions: All three prefill candidate/base ratios>1 and geomean>1.02 qualifies faster screen; all<1 and geomean<1/1.02 slower screen; otherwise inconclusive. Decode uses1.05 and1/1.05 with the same all-pair direction rule and generation-count ratios within1/1.05..1.05. Otherwise decode is inconclusive. Report acceptance change as candidate effect, never require equal acceptance or text. Nonregression is geomean>=0.98 and each ratio>=0.95 separately for PP and TG. Keep all samples/spreads. Strong-MTP classification requires all acceptance>=0.60. No automatic extra repeats or adoption.
plan.limits: Minimal-marker timing, not a zero-observer/overhead proof. Markers establish the successful batched callback and nominal cell coverage; they do not expose inner r0/needed rows, batch size or kernel dispatch. Fixed-source geometry/dispatch predicates establish the Q8/FP16 family only for work actually needed. Each sample is first long request after four warmups, not subsequent-long steady state. No comparison with old diagnostic TG establishes observer cost or hardware saturation. Weak-MTP,agent-session,task quality,physical262144/session/RESTORE and70TG remain pending.
